notes.title: "Autocrafting" Released!
notes.content:
We just released the autocrafting update! 

This will allow you to automate your base to a very high degree and automatically craft items in an assembler! In combination with the logistics system, the quarry and the autofarmer this brings this game to a whole new level of complexity!

Here you can see the assembler in action! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/c1c8c6ee0060a0b07f7621bde94c1c3a90109b6c.jpg[/img]

You can also design your own assembler in the object designer and we added autocrafting functionality to the arc furnace and to the mineral extractor!

We also added a Recycler which will allow you to destroy items. (materials you don't need from quarry for example!) Of course you can also design your own recycler in the object designer! In the future the recycler will also be able to dismantle items to get back their base resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/0e7b2035ef3eed3b5d5b7076fb3987a4d46acf72.jpg[/img]

We also added some creative energy source for creative mode so it's easier to try out stuff in creative mode which needs electricity! And of course we fixed a few bugs again! We hate bugs... they are nasty... uuurghh...


[h3]What's up next?[/h3]

Now we will start working on gas/fluid pipes, oxygen and fuels. This means players will actually need an oxygen atmosphere to survive. If you build a space station or a base on the moon you will have to supply your base interior with oxygen! Also plants won't grow in vacuum anymore and furnaces won't work without oxygen anymore.
Also rocket engines won't run on electricity anymore and will use fuel which also can be made out of alcohol which will be made out of sugarcanes for example.
After this we want to refine vehicles because we are not very happy with their state at the moment and want to make them more useful! This means we want to add vehicle drills, autopilots (drones!) and connectors to connect vehicles to your base. (pipes and electricity)
And of course we will continue to fix bugs!



[h3]Join us on Discord![/h3]

Don't miss the latest dev info and updates on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/AJJnxHz9N9]discord[/url] channel! Join us now! I said now!!! did you already join?

notes.title: Logistics Update #1 Released!
notes.content:
We just released another major update, the "Logistics Update #1"!

First of all, join our [url=discord.com/invite/AJJnxHz9N9]discord[/url] now to prove the earth is not flat!

Did you join? Alright, good, let's continue!
This update introduces a lot of things to make [b]transporting, sorting and storing[/b] items a lot easier! We added item transport pipes (gas and fluid pipes will come later!), pipe sorters, pipe crossings, blacklists/whitelists for all that, new UI, new chests and to supplement all this, inventory space is now limited and each inventory only holds a specific amount of weight! For your custom created blocks the weight they can hold and the weight they have even depends on their size and material!

We also fixed a lot of bugs and made the game more stable on top of that! See the full changelog below!


[h3]So, what can i do with all that stuff?[/h3]

You now can connect a lot of blocks (predefined and user created) to pipes and transport items through these pipes. You can also apply whitelists/blacklists to filter the items you want to transport. We also added a sorter block to allow you to sort items, to make a sorting facility for example. The possibilities are endless and it's another big step forward for the game to become what it should! Pipe placement is very free and you can make them any shape you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/16f595984484acaf0fc0370e1cf344b3084566f2.jpg[/img]


[h3]What about "user created blocks"?[/h3]

Since you can design your own blocks in this game, including functional ones like chests and workbenches this update has a huge effect on these type of blocks! Your custom created blocks' weight will depend on the material you have used and on the size! Also the size of the inventory in these kind of blocks will depend on how big you have designed them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/bfb10d8df5fa9115aaef56a811c7a3898081fcc5.jpg[/img]


[h3]What's next?[/h3]

The next few updates will be some bug fixes again and some cleanup. Following that the next milestone will be some automation stuff like quarries, auto-farming, and auto-crafting! Stay tuned and join our [url=discord.com/invite/AJJnxHz9N9]Discord[/url] server to get the latest news and updates!
Also take a look at our [url=https://trello.com/b/pRWzHr94/undefined-roadmap]roadmap[/url] to see what we're working on and what we have planned for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/b04a2cf06e87e44bafea6a73f2c2060d7de3b771.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Farming Update out Now!
notes.content:
Get ready to get your hands dirty because the "Farming Update" is out now! This update introduces the possibility to plant your own seeds and grow them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/6992bc7406efa59227a2b5e2cc401a23a3b818d5.png[/img]


Some details about this update:

[h3]Where can i plant seeds?[/h3]

You will be able to plant seeds directly into the ground (dirt) or into farming beds. Planting is only possible into dirt at the moment. To get that dirt you can either collect some in the area and place it down or you can use our new "secondary tool action" for shovels which will convert grass voxels into dirt ones. like that you can create beatiful farm fields and plant your seeds there. (like seen in the picture below). Of course you can also create some custom fences with our object designer and protect your farm fields with them ;) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/b1da80c8bef0ac2123906fda6d19cfc14611315b.png[/img]


[h3]Plant growth depending on light conditions[/h3]

After you have planted your seeds they will start growing. Depending on light conditions they will grow faster, slower or they will even not grow at all. This means a dark underground cave might not be the ideal spot to grow your wheat. But hey... do you remember our electrical update? With electrical light sources you can make plant growth happen again, even underground! You can even watch them get bigger and bigger in time! Also, glass doesn't block sunlight! (a small bug we had in internal tests :P)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/d00f08e0e23f3cbe2cbec23a63b5a48078eef222.png[/img]


[h3]Plant types depend on biome[/h3]

To get seeds of a specific plant you will need to find that plant in the world. Each biome will provide different spawns for plants. For example watermelons will be available in the jungle biome but can not be found in the grasslands biome. But as soon as you have the plants and the seeds you can grow them everywhere on the planet. (at least at the moment. this might change later)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/bd4eb5c36103b1e81a50ba1fe8195b79cf0bb266.png[/img]


[h3]Plant types[/h3]

For now we added 11 different types (we will add more plants later!). Cabbage, carrots, corn, eggplants, potatoes, pumpkins, sugarcane, tomatoes, watermelons, sunflowers and wheat. Each of them with their own nutrition value and spawn location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/fe1dd28f5899e0420d1ec70e75d2f61bacbb1254.png[/img]


[h3]What can i do with plants?[/h3]

A lot of plants will have different use cases. A lot of them are a good food source. Some of them also act as a kind of decoration and in later updates some of them will be used to produce fuels or can be used in crafting. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/5b90d02adaa8b6c9faf9c2b2ac5f0ff334536341.png[/img]


[h3]Changelog v3.1.2:[/h3]

- {ADDED} plant growth. You can now plant specific plants and harvest them. Plants can be planted in dirt (directly on the ground) or in the new farming beds. You can even see them getting bigger in the first stage. Growing has 3 stages. the first stage is from seed to empty plant. in this stage you can see it getting bigger. in the second stage it will grow its fruits. in the third stage you can harvest the plant.
- {ADDED} farming bed object
- {ADDED} plant growth is dependant on light (sunlight or electrical lights!). no light no growth
- {ADDED} spawns for new plants in the world. depending on biomes there are different plants you can find
- {ADDED} added seeds, growth process and fruits for the following plants: tomato, sugarcane, cabbage, carrot, corn, potato, pumpkin, sunflower, wheat, eggplant, watermelon. For the moment these are all food sources only, except for the sunflower. Sunflower can be used for decoration. Later these plants will have more use cases. (for example sugarcane will be used to produce alcohol based fuel). Also there will be added more plants later on.
- {ADDED} right click action for tools (shovel now converts grass to dirt which is useful for farming)

- {IMPROVED} running speed. it's now faster. (and is now in sync with running animation)
- {IMPROVED} blueberry item
- {IMPROVED} vegitation spawns in some biomes
- {IMPROVED} battery initial charge (higher initial charge)
- {IMPROVED} nutrition use. nutrition will now reduce faster when you are working (when your stamina drops)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
As you already know our next major update is the farming update. Progress on that is quite good and we get things done quicker as expected. (As you can see on our [url=https://trello.com/c/DYYSkQYA/23-farming]roadmap[/url]!) Here's a few things you can expect in this update:


[h3]Where can i plant seeds?[/h3]

You will be able to plant seeds directly into the ground (dirt) or into farming beds. Planting is only possible into dirt at the moment. To get that dirt you can either collect some in the area and place it down or you can use our new "secondary tool action" for shovels which will convert grass voxels into dirt ones. like that you can create beatiful farm fields and plant your seeds there. (like seen in the picture below). Of course you can also create some custom fences with our object designer and protect your farm fields with them ;) 


[h3]Plant growth depending on light conditions[/h3]

After you have planted your seeds they will start growing. Depending on light conditions they will grow faster, slower or they will even not grow at all. This means a dark underground cave might not be the ideal spot to grow your wheat. But hey... do you remember our electrical update? With electrical light sources you can make plant growth happen again, even underground!


[h3]Plant types depend on biome[/h3]

To get seeds of a specific plant you will need to find that plant in the world. Each biome will provide different spawns for plants. For example watermelons will be available in the jungle biome but can not be found in the grasslands biome. But as soon as you have the plants and the seeds you can grow them everywhere on the planet. (at least at the moment. this might change later)


[h3]Plant types[/h3]

In the beginning (we will add more plants later!) there will be about 11 different types of plants. Cabbage, carrots, corn, eggplants, potatoes, pumpkins, sugarcane, tomatoes, watermelons, sunflowers and wheat. 


[h3]What can i do with plants?[/h3]

A lot of plants will have different use cases. A lot of them are a good food source. Some of them also act as a kind of decoration and in later updates some of them will be used to produce fuels or can be used in crafting. 


When will this update be released you may ask :) Very soon! ;)

If you have any questions please join our [url=discord.com/invite/AJJnxHz9N9]discord[/url] channel and don't hesitate to ask! In the meantime we hope you enjoy our game! if you find any bugs or have any feedback please let us know!


Here's a small sneek peak on a tomato field with a farming bed in the background (also tomatoes):

Depending on light conditions they will grow faster, slower or they will even not grow at all.

notes.title: Progress!
notes.content:
[h1]Progress![/h1]

We're making progress and work got up to some pace. (Read below why we have been silent for some time now!) 

We moved our project over to Unreal Engine 5. This was a lot of work but due to the size and complexity of our game this was something we had to do, to make development easier and the code easier to maintain.

The electrical base functionality is already working well and currently we're implementing a lot of electrical machines into this base system. (Solar panels, electrical furnaces, lights, batteries, first iteration of nuclear reactors, etc...)

We're also adding a electricity requirement to already existing blocks like thrusters and cockpit seats! So building your spacecraft will be a little bit more challenging! There will also be a sort of "Landing Gear" so landing and parking your spacecraft will be easier and also less taxing on performance.

Also we're making a few improvements to spacetravel. At the moment it takes a very long time to get to the moon for example. We're aming to improve that too.

Can't wait until you guys can play it! As you've probably guessed, the next update will be the "Electrical update" which will bring the first iteration of electricity and electrical machines and items to the game. 

Here's a small preview of some machines and the cables. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941928/adcf2dd99f2adba6855a69666ff37dd171698b2d.png[/img]


[h1]Why we went silent[/h1]

There's a few reasons why we were silent and why our development paused for some time. The most important reason and also the main reason has been some severe medical issues for one of our team members. (i don't want to get into much detail here for obvious reasons). Following to that there had been some financial struggles too. And since we're a very small team this meant that there was basically a development stop. 

Unfortunately we handled this situation not very well and just went silent. This of course brought a lot of uncertainty to our customers and player base. And we want to apologise for that!

But we're back at work and are working on the game.

There will also be a sort of "Landing Gear" so landing and parking your spacecraft will be easier and also less taxing on performance.
